$comment: Handover type maps: the ONE table both halves of the rules are checked against. backend/tests/test_handover_types.py feeds it to app/services/handover_types.py (the runtime reading and the writes of the settings API, the agents API and the agent clean-ups); frontend/src/lib/handover-types.test.ts feeds it to lib/handover-types.ts (the settings screen, the agent configuration and the flow map). An empty map is the legacy mode, every target running every type; a map that holds a type is explicit, an untyped target running as delegate. 'legacy' is when targets run every type; 'added' the map once a target is added next to 'targets' (a stored target that runs every type is never narrowed, any other added target is recorded as delegate); 'removed' how the targets left run once one is removed ('all' is every type): a map that holds a type never turns into the legacy mode. Add a case here, never on one side only.
